Description

Public-URL paths for the Star Field experiment texture set (served from experiments/star-field/public/textures/). Solar-system maps are the Solar System Scope CC-BY 8k set; moons/dwarfs are NASA global mosaics (NASA-3D-Resources, USGS, JPL/Dawn HAMO, Askaniy albedo maps) — every catalog body carries real imagery, no procedural flats. The milky-way skybox is the 8k equirect panorama; exoplanet/system bodies stay procedural (no real imagery exists). Sole declaration site — consumers import members from this frozen map rather than re-declaring the literals (zero-hardcoding rule).
